# GOAT Striker Investigation

This five-minute analytics pitch is built like a professional sports investigation. It follows a clear storyline that separates raw numbers from real striker quality.

## What this site delivers

- A sharp introduction to the research question.
- A diagnosis of why total international goals is a limited ranking tool.
- A deeper look at scoring ability, efficiency, and era context.
- A composite GOAT ranking model based on evidence.
- A balanced recommendation and next-step caveats.

## Why this question matters

International goals are the most visible striker metric, but the greatest striker also combines:

- consistent impact,
- high-quality scoring,
- and strong performance across different eras.

The rest of the site turns that professional view into a data story.
